cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: an open gantry stairway up the side of a docked ship — standing with one foot up on a step; A quiet floating relaxation capsule above a luminous nocturnal ocean — She reaches for a drifting sleep mask after the capsule gravity gently lowers; a lantern-lit old-town street at night — standing; A transparent orbital sightseeing elevator moving above a blue planet in late morning — She watches a weightless paper souvenir spiral beside the window and gently blows it toward the glass; the stone stairway up to an old city gate tower — holds a small hand lantern low at her side; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing; her crew cabin aboard a starship — lying on her left side; her living room with a deep sofa — holds a folded cleaning cloth at chest height; a club powder room with a lit mirror and neon on the tiles — standing; a flat dark rock in a pool at the foot of a tall waterfall — standing and leaning her upper body forward toward the camera from the hips; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — sitting on the ground; the equipment room of a swimming club — standing; a present-day museum gallery of Three Kingdoms relics — rests the pen from a notebook against her lips
